subject: [video] WP05 header available soon; n2vt_say fallback
body: vt/n2avc_vt.h will declare exactly: OSStatus n2avc_vt_create(uint32_t codecType, CFAllocatorRef allocator, VTVideoEncoderRef *instanceOut), weak_import except under N2_HOST_FAKE. In n2avc_vt.c I include "n2vt_log.h" only if __has_include finds it; otherwise a static inline no-op n2vt_say. No action needed unless your header/signature differs.
